semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports the complete original bracket-prefix/subformat lexer and condition-number/combining helpers. Source token values, locale-owned H/MI/S classification, mutable ASCII blank removal, literal quoting, combining-unit parity, NatNum0..19 and DBNum1..9 classification and cursor behavior are retained. Keyword numeric conversion uses the actual bounded o3tl/SAL integer implementation, without JavaScript numeric parsing. The original constructor still needs integration of these stages and the required prefix metadata; this fragment alone does not fix CSV recognition or the my-MM constructor regression.
